Priya S.: flagging a failure we saw in the Orchids private cluster after the RBAC rolebinding change last night. Model pods are getting KMS errors during key unwrap. Jumpbox and sidecars work fine. Anyone seen this pattern?
Ethan: which binding? clusterRoleBinding or IAM binding to the key?
Priya S.: we added a ClusterRoleBinding to give `inference-runtime` SA more privileges for tenant provisioning. suspect it accidentally allowed a different SA identity string to be used for KMS calls.
Lukas: curious: cloud logs show grpc call with principalEmail = 'system:serviceaccount:tenant-ns:inference-runtime'. KMS expects a cloud service account email, not a k8s SA. Did we have the workload identity bridge in that tenant?
Priya S.: tenant is using workload-identity-shim (our shim) so it should exchange to org SA. logs show shim returning an org SA, but the KMS call still had the k8s principal.
Maya: that implies the shim couldn't attach the short-lived token, maybe because the pod can talk to KMS directly and bypasses the gateway (race). We should force egress to the gateway and block 443 to KMS.
Priya S.: agree. Also we need auditable path for keys: all decrypt/encrypt should be visible in tenant logs and our audit pipeline. Right now DATA_ACCESS is enabled at org level only.
Ethan: proposal: 1) block direct egress to cloud-kms from tenant-ns using CiliumNetworkPolicy deny-all-egress except to 203.0.113.45 (kms-proxy). 2) require SPIFFE SVID from shim to kms-proxy; proxy validates SVID and mints KMS call as the org SA. 3) export KMS DATA_ACCESS to tenant logging sink and our central SIEM with per-request correlation id.
Lukas: for SPIFFE use, the shim must get SVID from the platform CA (we already have cert-manager+SPIFFE integration in staging). Make sure SVID TTL is very short (<60s) and bind to pod UID to avoid reuse.
Maya: vuln triage notes: proxy needs replay protection, strict auditable request headers, rate limit, and hardened TLS ciphers. We should avoid reintroducing a broad service account that can call KMS for all tenants. Instead proxy enforces per-tenant key ACLs.
Priya S.: can someone draft the netpol? I can open the infra PR. Also we need a fallback in case proxy is down  how do we fail? degrade gracefully or return 5xx?
Ethan: fail closed for Decrypt ops (return error) to avoid leaking plaintext. For Encrypt (if used for logs) we can queue to retry. Document in runbook.
Lukas: netpol draft (Cilium):
```
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-egress-lockdown
spec:
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inference-runtime
  egress:
  - toEntities: ["world"]
    toEndpoints:
    - matchLabels:
        role: kms-proxy
    toPorts:
    - ports:
      - port: "443"
        protocol: TCP
  - toFQDNs:
    - matchName: "internal-svc.kms-proxy.svc.cluster.local"
    - matchName: "oauth2.googleapis.com"
  ingress: []
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
```
Lukas: will tighten to deny world except proxy; iterate.
Maya: for audit: add correlation-id header (X-RW-CID) from shim on every KMS call, log at proxy, and set a LEGACY_LOG field so we can export to tenant sink. We'll also enable KMS DATA_ACCESS logs at tenant project.
Priya S.: action items: (1) Lukas to finalize Cilium policy and PR; (2) Ethan to spec SPIFFE SVID flow + TTL + binding; (3) Maya to run vuln triage and produce checklist (nonce, single-use, audience, tls hardening); (4) infra to add logging export and SIEM mapping.
infra-bot: Noted. Scheduling canary: staging 15% tomorrow 03:00 UTC, full rollout Thurs 02:00 UTC pending approvals.
Ethan: threat-model corner cases: shim compromise, proxy compromise, replay of SVID, token theft via pod logs. Mitigations: SVID short TTL, bind to pod UID/IP, strict no-write to logs of tokens, and limit proxy's KMS scope to per-tenant keys only.
Maya: also include regression tests: simulate missing IAM grant and verify proxy still returns audited 403 and no direct decrypt occurs from pod. Add e2e test that asserts tenant logs contain DATA_ACCESS entry with correlation id.
Priya S.: good. I'll open INC ticket and short runbook.
